projectDescription: An AI-powered no-code app builder that lets non-technical users describe what they want and instantly generates real, deployable web apps with built-in cloud infrastructure.
keyFeatures: AI-powered app generation from natural language descriptions
Built-in Genie Cloud with database, auth, storage, and edge functions
Project templates for common use cases (portfolios, dashboards, CRMs, etc.)
MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations with tools like Linear, GitHub, Notion, Stripe
Project secrets management for secure environment variable storage
Custom domain support for published projects
Community showcase to explore and remix public projects
Team workspaces with roles and permissions
publicApiSurface: POST /api/chat — send a prompt to generate or update a project
GET /api/plan — retrieve the current user's plan and credit balance
GET /api/billing/prices — fetch live Stripe pricing by interval
GET /api/mcp — MCP server endpoint for AI tool integrations
GET /api/preview — live preview of a project
POST /api/cloud — enable or manage Genie Cloud for a project
